description: Activated Volumes in Belgium (Near real-time) is a dataset listed in Elia open data platform, an open data platform of a transmission system operator, published or maintained by Elia Group. This report of activated volumes provides information on the balancing energy activated in Belgium for Elia or other TSOs.The quarter-hourly volume is provided for each product category (if the product was actually used).This report contains data for the current day and is refreshed every 15min.﻿This dataset contains data from 22/05/2024 (MARI local go-live) on. Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Balancing. Its keywords are Market, Imbalance prices. The portal shows 2025-06-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Elia Open Data Licence (/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-elia-open-data-portal.
